headline: Import Policy Amended, Restriction Clause on Knitted Fabrics Removed
summary: Bangladesh has amended its import policy and removed the restriction clause on knitted fabrics. The report gives no further details on the scope of the change.
why: Import rules on textile inputs affect the cost and sourcing of raw materials for Bangladesh's large garment export industry.
